style: Cinematic 65mm natural history cinematography, shot on wide-angle prime lenses with deep environmental focus, captured under low overcast Pacific dusk and austere oceanic dawn light, featuring deep basalt-black shadows (#101214) contrasted against incandescent magma-orange (#FF7A1A) thermal vents, organic atmospheric haze, fine 35mm grain, and a solemn, monumentally scaled observational tone.
collage_style: Precision scientific-editorial collage combining matte cut-out geological cross-sections, tactile archival rag paper textures, and flat graphic fields of deep basalt-black (#101214) accented by clean technical lines and heat gradients in saturated magma-orange (#FF7A1A), arranged with rigorous minimalist documentary clarity.
